It was the home of Kate Chopin, author of "The Awakening", after her marriage. The house was located on Main Street (Louisiana Highway 1) in New Orleans, in Orleans Parish, Louisiana. The home was built by the town's founder, Alexis Cloutier and was constructed in a combination of handmade brick, hand-hewn cypress boards, and bousillage.
